title: Stack Overflow standardizes on a version-controlled CI/CD pipeline for its enterprise solution - Octopus Deploy
markdown:

#### Requirements

Tenanted deployments

Config as Code

Automate operations

![Company icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/27ba107a3d/company-icon.svg)

#### Company

500 - 2500 employees

![Industry IT and Technology icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/67x67/302e46d7de/industry-it-and-technology-icon.svg)

#### Industry

IT & Technology

> ![Stackoverflow logo orange](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/250x32/d1584ee399/stack-overflow-orange-sm.svg)
>
> _Octopus closed the gap for us, so we can now deploy to both our data center and cloud service providers._

![Stack Overflow CI/CD pipeline](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/2242x954/b8973be5e8/use-case-stackoverflow.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![Stack Overflow CI/CD pipeline mobile](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/1094x785/f7c4308e60/use-case-stackoverflow-mobile.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

> ![Stackoverflow logo orange](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/250x32/d1584ee399/stack-overflow-orange-sm.svg)
>
> _One PR allows you to run a parallel process (that is, you can do whatever you want in a branch) and you can change the software and how it’s deployed... I was able to quickly create a PR to test out the workflow and have a coworker review it (seeing the diff changes in GitHub) and merge it in._
